digest.component_or_area: adapters/jira_datacenter — Jira Data Center transport on pycontribs/jira
propositions: DC transport delegates to pycontribs/jira library rather than hand-rolling urllib, confined to opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra with lazy import so 'import rebar' has zero dependencies

Every transport method returns raw REST payload shapes (dict with key/fields/etc) already consumed by rebar mappers, not jira.Issue objects, verified through shared _jira_shape_contract assertions against both unit fakes and live Jira instance
PAT bearer token auth from JIRA_PAT env var, URL/project from typed config, malformed config raises ConfigError loudly rather than degrading to env-only

Non-https base_url rejected with ConfigError unless allow_insecure=true; certificate verification never disabled; ca_bundle config supports internal CAs; resolved_statuses configures absence probe's resolved-status set (default {Resolved, Done, Cancelled})
Retry policy mirrors acli_rest: ConnectionError/Timeout retried with 2s/5s backoff, HTTP errors never retried, unknown assignee raises BackendAssigneeNotFoundError

All 13 TicketTransport/SupportsLinks/SupportsComments/SupportsAbsenceProbe methods live-tested against J5 Jira 8.17.1 harness; NameIdentity user-search resolver wired with real lookup for authoritative identity resolution
